method.transferUnits: Playwright responseBodySize bytes for completed positive-size script responses
method.coverageUnits: UTF-16 source characters reported by V8
method.coverageScope: main renderer, URL-bearing parsed scripts; workers excluded
method.coverageCaveat: Coverage records source ranges entered during this exact workflow. It is not a byte-for-byte attribution of compressed transfer, and repeated document contexts can execute the same cached source more than once.
